name: autologger
description: AutoLogger — portable Node server + React frontend (npm workspaces)

scripts.test: node --test docker/scripts/compose-run.test.mjs docker/scripts/supabase-keys.test.mjs && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm run test -w companion && npm run test -w packages/domain && npm run test -w packages/contract && npm run test -w packages/ports && npm run test -w packages/storage && npm run test -w packages/catalog && npm run test -w packages/session-core && npm run test -w packages/transcription && npm run test -w packages/media-import && npm run test -w packages/log-import && npm run test -w packages/ai-runtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.node.json && npm run typecheck -w companion && tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contract && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ports && tsc --noEmit -p packages/storage && tsc --noEmit -p packages/catalog && tsc --noEmit -p packages/session-core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/transcription && tsc --noEmit -p packages/media-import && tsc --noEmit -p packages/log-import && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ai-runtime
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && biome check --error-on-warnings companion/src server/src packages
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w web && biome check --write companion/src server/src packages
